decision: No new substantial proposal accepted; duplicate/deferred
corrections: Address-only distance1 rolling L2 prefetch is exactly the already-tested implementation, not a refinement/new proposal.
Zero spills do not prove why allocation improved or that any stalls were removed. ptxas cannot report Stall Long Scoreboard relief; that requires actual GPU profiling.
No proof that this is the only affordable latency-hiding strategy. Divergent addresses do not imply universal serialization; distinguish address spaces and hardware behavior.

Required accumulator/deferred-anchor recurrence cannot simply be discarded. Shared spilling adds traffic and can reduce occupancy; generic RegDem results are not a new end-to-end gain for our now-zero-spill variant.
workflow_improvement: Strengthened novelty comparison and static-versus-runtime evidence requirements in next-round prompt.
